summary: NKGen Biotech filed an 8-K regarding a first amendment to an existing equity and business loan agreement with BDW Investments. The amendment modifies the security interest from an all-assets lien to a first-priority perfected security interest in certain real estate collateral, adjusts permitted lien definitions, and updates the definition of senior loan to reference a convertible loan agreement with AlpineBrook Capital. A release of claims was granted by the borrower and company to the lender. This is a routine debt amendment, not a special situation.
